sections.heading: Prayer of the Apostle Paul
sections.body: *Translated by Samuel Zinner; edited by Mark Mattison (Other Gospels Nag Hammadi Initiative)*

sections.heading: 1. The Petition for Union
sections.body:
**1.** [...]
 [your] light, grant me your [mercy].

**2.** My redeemer, redeem me, for [I am] yours,
 the one who came forth from you.

**3.** You are [my] mind; give birth to me.
 You are my house of treasures; open for me.

**4.** You [are] my fullness; embrace me.
 You are repose; grant me [the] ungraspable perfection.

sections.heading: 2. The Petition for Authority
sections.body:
**1.** I pray to you, the one who is and was,
 in the name [that is] exalted above every name, through Jesus Christ,
 [the Lord] of Lords, King of the worlds.

**2.** Grant me your gifts, which you regret not,
 through the Son of Man,
 the Spirit, the Paraclete [of truth].

**3.** Grant me authority [when I] petition you,
 grant me bodily healing when I petition you through the evangelist,

**4.** [and] redeem my eternal soul of light, and my spirit;
 and the firstborn of the Fullness of grace, to my mind reveal him.

sections.heading: 3. The Petition for Gnosis
sections.body:
**1.** Grant what the eye of angels has not [seen],
 and what the ear of archons has not heard,
 and what has not entered the human mind,

**2.** which became angelic, and according to the image of the god of the soul,
 when it was fashioned in the beginning,
 because I have faith and hope.

**3.** And set upon me your beloved, elect, blessed Majesty,
 you who are the First-born, the First-begotten,
 and the [wonderful] mystery of your house.

**4.** [For] yours is the power [and] the glory
 and the praise and the greatness,
 forever and ever. [Amen].

Prayer of Paul, [the] Apostle
In Peace.
Christ is holy.

---
